claim_policy.public_source_verified: Evidence points to public source pinned to an immutable Git commit.
claim_policy.private_source_verified: Evidence was checked against private operator-controlled source; public readers cannot independently inspect it.
claim_policy.operator_attested: The claim describes operator practice and is an attestation, not independently verifiable public-source evidence.
claim_policy.explainer_local_verified: Evidence is in this public explainer source pinned to an immutable Git commit.

claims.summary: Outbound control-plane actions pass through durable draft, approval, one-use confirmation, and bounded execution states.

evidence.locator: approval state machine and confirmation-token boundary

claims.summary: A SQLite-backed bridge carries activity, handoff, snapshot, cost, and long-lived context records with searchable recall and protected lifecycle tags.

evidence.locator: README.md sections Architecture, Tools, Trust, and Retention

claims.summary: The explainer replays one committed deterministic synthetic dataset on a shared session clock with no live data wiring.
Control-plane read adapters classify evidence freshness and allow alerting only from fresh inputs.

evidence.locator: spoke freshness policy and alert eligibility boundary

claims.summary: Work is routed by task ownership and required capability, while model tiers are selected by the judgment and risk profile of the role.

evidence.locator: fleet routing and model-tier operating practice

claims.summary: Parallel implementation lanes use isolated worktrees and converge through a parent-owned integration path with verification before publication.

evidence.locator: parallel delivery and integration operating practice

claims.summary: Consequential work is constrained by overlapping intent, pattern, policy, confidence, verification, and integrity gates.
The public build is guarded by closed synthetic vocabularies, deterministic regeneration, forbidden-pattern scanning, and disabled source maps.
